name: Debasement
body:
Spiteful misers deliberately place this curse on their treasure vaults—if they can’t have their loot, no one can.

Type curse; Save Will DC 15; Frequency 1/day

EFFECTS

The victim’s valuables rapidly degrade: gems crack, coins transform into lesser metals, objects of art deteriorate, and so on. Each day, mundane items of value—things that aren’t magic items, tools, weapons, armor, food, or living matter—in the accursed’s possession lose 5% of their value. This repeats each day until someone else assumes possession of the items or the items become worthless (coins are transformed into iron slugs, gems into misshapen glass lumps, jewelry into malformed tin, and art objects into amateurish dreck).
